propositions: Plan-review Pass-4 coaching renders feedback per finding instance rather than per root cause, causing authors to receive N instance-level fixes when multiple findings share one methodological failure such as incomplete enumeration.

When an author repeatedly fixes named instances of a pattern across multiple review passes without enumerating the full population, the review loop does not terminate until an acceptance criterion with machine-checkable completeness proof is introduced.
No existing coaching move (including move 12 'Generalize') requires verifiable proof of completeness for population-scoped findings; move 12 relies on unverifiable author assertions.
A new built-in coaching move scoped to criteria where populations exist (G1G2, E4, G6, A1) must reframe named instances as samples and mandate machine-checkable acceptance criteria.
